criteria.requirement: Add ContextScope(Scope), contextscope decorator and enter() context using an instance-owned ContextVar plus thread/task ownership. Actual Injector.get of a bound class reuses one successful instance within its explicit active scope, nested enter gets fresh instances then restores outer tokens, and exit/failure/cancellation removes scope state. Concurrent asyncio tasks each explicitly enter and remain isolated; inherited parent context in a child task is not implicitly owned and must reject get until entering. Failed providers never populate cache. Preserve NoScope/Singleton/ThreadLocal semantics and do not implicitly close unmanaged resources or use a global mutable task cache.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
